title: The Network Luncheon- Open to the Community
seo_title: The Network Luncheon at Crosslines in Springfield, MO
description: The Network Luncheon is a casual networking lunch where you can eat a meal, meet local business, church, and community leaders, and hear a talk from a community member. This month's speaker is James E. Meadows, a shareholder at Carnahan Evans who handles business and real estate disputes, and anyone is welcome. It takes place December 3, 2026 (time listed as TBD, though lunch begins at noon) in the Chapel at Crosslines Community Outreach, 3055 E. Division St., Springfield, MO.
